rounds.text: Value 360 Communications Ltd trades at an attractive P/E multiple of 13.5x [E1], which sits starkly below its sector benchmark of 47.49x [E5]. The business delivers exceptional returns on capital, boasting an ROCE of 37.02% [E9] and an ROE of 31.9% [E8], both of which drastically outperform sector medians of 20.25% [E9] and 16.83% [E8] respectively. This high-return profile is backed by robust fundamental momentum, demonstrated by trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 28% [E13] and an impressive 64% surge in profit growth [E14]. Furthermore, operating margins have expanded significantly by 13 percentage points to reach 26% [E17], supported by a multi-year uptrend in operating performance [E18]. Adding to this fundamental strength, a discounted cash flow analysis estimates intrinsic value at Rs 127 per share against a market price of Rs 75.6, offering a substantial 40.5% margin of safety [E30, E31]. Conceded: the company pays a 0.00% dividend yield [E3], exhibits negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.22 Cr for Mar 2026 [E21], and maintains high debtors of 168 days [E36].

Value 360 Communications Ltd trades at an attractive P/E ratio of 13.5x [E1], which is heavily discounted compared to its sector benchmark P/E of 47.49x [E5]. The business demonstrates exceptional operational quality, boasting an ROE of 31.9% and an ROCE of 37.02%, both vastly outperforming sector benchmarks of 16.83% and 20.25% respectively [E8, E9]. Growth momentum is robust, highlighted by a compounded sales growth of 28% and a compounded profit growth of 64% over the trailing twelve months [E13, E14]. This financial strength is further reinforced by expanding operating margins, which climbed to 26% in March 2026—a 13 percentage point increase over three years—backed by a multi-year uptrend in both sales and profits [E17, E41, E42]. Furthermore, a reverse DCF indicates that the current market price implies an earnings growth rate of just 2.8%, sitting well below the base case assumption of 10.0% and offering substantial analytical upside [E32]. Conceded: cash conversion is negative at -0.02x with operating cash flow dropping to Rs -0.22 Cr, and high debtors of 168 days are flagged by Screener [E20, E21, E36].
